# Private actual-parent retained lexical windows

This source-only probe extends the immutable page and linkage releases. It does
not change canonical files, registration, resident code, Make or Git. Run:

```sh
python3 tests/test_cache_lexical_editor.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture
```

`--build-only` measures actual linkage. The builder pins the released link-source
SHA and extracts original lexer/controller/arena/query sources from the frozen
product ZIP. Earlier component sources remain unchanged. No generated GSEM,
CR, CP79 or page reference is seeded into the renderer by the host.

## What actually executes

The real public editor creates the semantic baseline. Actual C35 classification
feeds the released C29/R26 lexical producer and genuine one-page COW linker.
The committed root advertises flags5 (BASE1|LEX4), private lexABI1, per-CR flag10
hex and actual lexical ref/count. The public editor then processes two F4 wrap
changes and renders again. Both real layout publications invalidate the primary
packet authority, so actual C21/C20 construct the windows; a same-mode99 request
alone was insufficient and reused the existing primary. That rejected verifier
attempt is preserved, not counted as a retained lexical hit.

The new C25 gateway consumes only the real parent's immutable21-byte GSEM input.
Full, count1..128 and logical BODY>=256 are required to attempt retention; this
threshold is a conservative private policy, not an empirically optimal cutoff.
Shortcode chooses the original fallback. Plain/Markdown retain their real parent
bypass. Eligible windows acquire a real R14 source lease, verify the visible8200
packet against actual source in <=32-byte reads, advancing by actual returned
count (not requested count), then call a borrowed-lease root/CR resolver.

The resolver is the released link capsule with LINK/source-acquisition removed
from its public entry. Its new borrowed entry requires an actual live owned
reader; every metadata step rechecks all59 source fields, source object graphs,
observer tuple, typed arena and complete root/page CRCs. It never calls R14 or
another R leaf. C25 sequentially calls R14, R30 and R26; there is no R-to-R or
C-to-C nesting. The actual released R26 consumer resolves the committed CR's
returned ref, validates the complete lexical descriptor/payload, then produces
roles. The gateway copies these to8300, restores the immutable8200 packet and
ends the counted source lease. Resident STOP uses the real saved86-byte source
snapshot and flags9040/912C/912D. Changed accepted GSEM inputs errorB1; optional
metadata/module misses choose the original strict fallback, never partial roles.

Original C25 remains a separate private C39 image. Byte comparison against the
frozen packaged C25 requires exactly one changed byte: offset941 REQUEST ID25
becomes39; every other byte, including actual lexer and guards, is identical.
The existing root's odd-worker continuation returns to the real C21 caller.

## Classification prerequisite is explicit

Old C35 rejects rootflags5/lexABI1 with C2. A forced real render demonstrated the
failure, rather than silently falling back to C24. This probe therefore includes
a separate strict semantic-only C35 profile. It accepts exactly flags1/lexABI0
or flags5/lexABI1, accepts CR lexical-complete only under the latter root, and
retains source/CRC/record guards. Flags3 (mapped),7 (combined) and unknowns still
refuse. It consumes retained real block metadata, not parser reconstruction.
It has no PAGE_REUSE/forward certificate or outgoing CP79 proof. This costs
additional CR lookups and disables associated incremental certificates. It is
not suitable as a replacement for the ordinary production C35 profile.

## Actual budgets and lifetimes

| Component | Linked bytes |
| --- | ---: |
| C25 gateway |748|
| strict generic C35 |4066|
| borrowed-lease R30 resolver |3935|
| original fallback, one REQUEST operand changed |4059|
| unchanged producer/page/link dependencies |3993 /3917 /4095|

No new resident BSS, ZP, object or bank. Gateway control uses dead source-worker
phase9096..90EB after C20, preserves packet in8F40..8FBF, and uses the existing
576-byte cache frame during metadata calls. Saved source9040..9095, packet90EC..
910B, parent9134..9177 and GSEM8B40..8BFF have separate lifetimes. R30 doesn't
overwrite the packet park. No field survives a source/layout job without the
existing checked source/arena authority.

The probe substitutes existing C5/eplay, C29/lifectrl, R26/lifecopy, C25/geoslex,
R30/gtype, C39/line and C35/inln images in its private54-image import only.
Those are used production modules. **This is not free production capacity.**
Actual registration, fallback placement, forward-cache coexistence, lifecycle
and resident dispatch need a separate design/qualification. This source-only
test does not package a deployable replacement D81.

## Measured result and no-promotion decision

For source1023 bytes with one998-byte BASIC BODY, each forced public rebuild has
19 positive actual cache-hit PC calls, zero actual lexer feeds,21 real rows.
The unchanged packaged baseline feeds998*19=18962 bytes each time. All64000
pixels,1000 attributes, row anchors and roles match independent canonical/font
oracles and the packaged baseline. No source, history, catalog or shim changes.
Whole16MiB comparison permits only the existing typed FE header64 and source
packet/cache region0200..EA87; the entire typed53 arena remains read-only.

Actual6510 instructions include public double-F4 input, navigation, guards,
overlay admission/loads and full rendering, not just zero lexer calls:

| Case | Probe | Packaged baseline |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| first forced rebuild |5306219|5957302|
| warm forced rebuild |5250321|5901542|
| producer+link |578812 (16 loads)|—|
| first rebuild including producer+link |5885031|5957302|
| Markdown bypass |3185094|2057891|
| short22-byte BODY fallback |935165|729273|

The first total improves only about1.2%; warm rebuild about11%. Markdown and
short-body costs regress because of the generic classifier profile. More
overlays are loaded on eligible redraws (226 warm versus212 baseline). Do not
promote this profile. It proves actual parent consumption, not a universal
speedup or production policy. Common initial source import/semantic baseline
and setup render are excluded from both compared forced intervals. Their prior
cost is not disguised as a cache benefit. These are CPU instructions, not native
cycles, emulated latency or physical responsiveness.

Ten frames also cover missing resolver/consumer with exact strict fallback,
STOP while a cached role job owns a lease and successful rebuild, actual GSEM
mutation→B1/cleanup/recovery, Plain/Markdown zero feeds, and shortcode bypass.
The missing-module and recovery images are byte-identical to the retained image.
Four unique CPU images (Full, Plain, Markdown, short Full) were inspected in the
contact sheet. No native/VIC, preview, editing/undo, mappedflags3/7, source rekey,
public W_LOAD reuse,64KiB parent window or broader lifecycle claim is made.

Next private work must preserve ordinary PAGE_REUSE/forward-cache classification
and its actual source/CRC authority, avoid charging the generic profile to Plain/
Markdown/shortcode, and establish a real placement/continuation budget before
revisiting promotion. The existing root's flags1/3 reader and forward proofs may
not silently authorize5/7 or a lexical reference.
